title: HustleBox v1.3.4 — Cutscene Fix, Settings Hub, Smaller Home Text
message:
Three real bugs and a UX refactor.

FIXED: CUTSCENE NEVER ENDED
The back room cutscene played through but the room never appeared — you had to tap SKIP. Root cause: the setTimeout that scheduled the auto-advance depended on the onDone prop, which was a new arrow function on every parent re-render. The side hustle timer ticks the parent every second, which propagated down, which kept resetting the 4.4-second timer. The timer literally never reached the end. Switched to a useRef-based pattern that captures the latest callback without re-firing the effect.

CUTSCENE VISUALS
The door is no longer floating in the void — it now scales and walks along the perspective floor toward the viewer, so it visually sits ON the ground at all times. The floating arm that was supposed to be reaching for the doorknob is removed; without an articulated shoulder it just looked like a random orange limb. The pulsing doorknob glow sells 'you're about to open the door' on its own.

SETTINGS RESTRUCTURED INTO A HUB
Settings is now a 4-item list:
• 🔊 Sound & Visual — SFX, ambience, customer voices, vibration, bold update log
• 🔔 Notifications — coming soon placeholder
• 👤 Account — friend code, sign-in/out, cloud sync status
• ℹ️ About — version, logo, view update log, reset save

Tap any one to enter its sub-page. Each sub-page is short enough that you don't need to scroll. The back arrow on each sub-page returns to the Settings hub; the arrow on the hub returns to the More menu.

HOME TEXT SMALLER
Screen titles were 32px on mobile (36px on desktop) — felt oversized next to emoji-heavy content. Bumped down to 24px mobile / 30px desktop. Side hustle widget text reduced as well — button labels 13px (was 16px), descriptors 9px (was 10px). Side hustle description shortened to 'Quick errands. Run in the background.' Active hustle name is 13px now instead of default.

FRIENDS — REVIEWED, NOT CHANGED
You asked me to test the friends system. I read through the friend-add, QR generation, and Firestore handlers — nothing jumped out as broken. The code paths are: copy code, copy invite link, show QR, accept incoming friend via ?friend=CODE URL. If something is misbehaving, send me the exact action and what you see and I'll dig in. I can't reproduce friends-flow without two devices.

No save data wiped.

entries.title: Cutscene Fix, Settings Hub, Smaller Home Text
highlights: FIXED: cutscene never advanced past fade-to-black — useRef pattern so re-renders don't reset the timer
Cutscene visuals: door walks along the floor toward the viewer instead of floating; removed the orphan arm
Settings restructured into a hub-and-spoke with 4 sub-pages (Sound & Visual, Notifications, Account, About) so each fits without scrolling
Home screen titles smaller (24px mobile, 30px desktop) — was oversized
Side hustle widget compacted (13px button text, shorter description)
Reviewed friend-add/QR code paths — no bugs found, send specific repro if something's off
